description: Address code review issues: wire metrics.record_request(), fix CSP for Swagger UI paths, remove dead global_exception_handler registration, and add trade-off comments for known hackathon limitations.
steps: Wire metrics.record_request(path, response_time_ms) into StructuredLoggingMiddleware.dispatch after computing response time
Exclude /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json from CSP header in SecurityHeadersMiddleware
Remove app.add_exception_handler(Exception, global_exception_handler) from main.py and clean up the import
Add comment in error_handler.py documenting its role as backup/reference
Add trade-off comments in rate_limiter.py (proxy keys), metrics.py (thread safety), explainer.py (feature divergence), and batch endpoint (blocking)
acceptance_criteria: metrics.record_request() is called in the logging middleware for every request
/docs, /redoc, /openapi.json paths do not receive CSP header
global_exception_handler is not registered in main.py
